aj: FYI — handing off weekend release watch. I'm on until 20:00 PT, then sofia takes over. Main work: canary rollout of inference v2.8. No hotfixes planned.
sofia: ack. what's the expected risk profile? any migrations?
aj: low-medium. model binary change + small KV-schema bump in redis for cache invalidation. Migration script is online but quick.
maya: can you drop the migration command here?
aj: sure:
```bash
./scripts/migrate-cache-schema --env=prod --dry-run=false
```
aj: run after canary passes for 10m. If errors, rollback with:
```bash
./scripts/migrate-cache-schema --rollback
```
liam: who will be the primary watcher for canary (0.1 -> 1.0)?
sofia: I can be primary for initial 0.1 -> 0.5. @maya do you want to be secondary for the 0.5 -> 1.0?
maya: I can do secondary but only after 22:00 PT, tag me for escalation before that.
aj: noted. watchers list: sofia(primary 0.1-0.5), maya(secondary 0.5-1.0), liam(smoke tester 0.5+)
devops-svcs: Scheduled Canary at 2026-03-20T01:00Z. Watcher rotation set: sofia -> maya.
oncall-bot: Reminder: deploy freeze window 01:00-03:00Z only allows rollback/urgent fixes. See runbook https://internal/runbooks/release-watch
sofia: also expect a small latency bump (~10-20ms p50) during initial shard warmup. We'll monitor p99.
maya: I'll run the smoke tests below once 0.5 is at 50%:
- curl -sS https://api.prod/redwood/health | jq '.ok'
- sample gen: `curl -X POST -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' https://api.prod/redwood/gen`
liam: tagging @sofia for logs: if p99 > 500ms or error rate > 0.5% for 5m, revert to v2.7 per rollback steps in runbook.
sofia: got it. I'll post a quick status message at each major step. ping me on slack call if urgent :phone: 
aj: thanks all — leaving notes in #eng-oncall-status and marking handoff done. :white_check_mark:
